credits.title: Mother Machine
credits.overview: Aom longs to return to acting, but the weight of motherhood keeps her tethered. Torn between desire and expectation, she must decide whose story she will live.

credits.title: Operation Undead
credits.overview: Inexperienced Thai soldiers battle a growing undead menace in this gruesome survival horror. A Japanese military experiment that turns men into monsters escapes containment, it’s up to these troops to save their nation from annihilation.
